en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a large, grand castle with four circular towers topped with distinctive domes and finials, a central spire, and numerous windows. The castle is situated behind a body of water and rows of manicured trees. The text 'Kgl. Jagdschloss Moritzburg.' appears in red at the bottom, and smaller print at the lower left indicates the publisher's details: '4404 Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
